name: Spritelith
storyline: Step through. Throw down. A pixel-art fighting adventure across five realms, with creatures, machines and unlikely challengers. Five realms. One fight. Coming to Rookie Gamers.
summary: Five realms. One fight. Step through. Throw down. Spritelith is a pixel-art fighting adventure across five realms (Rimewake, Jadeveil, Crownfall, Brasshollow and Elderreach), with creatures, machines and unlikely challengers. Choose your fighter, cross the gateway into a realm and its arena, and take the match in a best-of-three. The first faces through the gateway are the High Five: Dax Calder, Vesper Vale, Orren Voss, The Velvet Regent and Grinwick.
